ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $a\parallel b\parallel c$, $\frac{AC}{CE}=\frac{1}{2}$, and $DF=12$, what is the length of $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $a\parallel b\parallel c$,\\
it follows that $\frac{AC}{CE}=\frac{BD}{DF}=\frac{1}{2}$,\\
since $DF=12$,\\
it follows that $\frac{BD}{12}=\frac{1}{2}$,\\
therefore, $BD=\boxed{6}$.
